evidence_classes.repository_evidence: manifests, run records, raw/artifact layer layout on disk

cord.note: The six parquet shards and split census are pinned in manifests/datasets/cord.json. Repository freshness and local acquisition state are reported separately below; upstream availability is not itself a freshness claim.

eligibility_rules.sgv1_confirmatory_eligible: document never consumed in any role by any prior phase (h1_pilot/recovery/cgv2/cgv3) nor by any SGV1 development role; dataset license permits use
eligibility_rules.sgv1_dev_eligible: prior-phase documents are reusable as SGV1 TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT under a fresh SGV1 partition; they can never be confirmatory

funsd.note: Fully consumed. The corpus used sorted(training_data)[:100]; cgv3's confirmatory run consumed the remaining 49 training + all 50 testing documents on 2026-08-28. Prior-phase documents may serve as SGV1 TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT material under a fresh SGV1 partition; they can never be confirmatory.

cord.sgv1_confirmatory_eligible_pool: qualified train/validation pool after historical-near and pre-role-access exclusions; exact ids are bound by confirmatory_eligible_ids_sha256
cord.note: CORD test is consumed with prior roles exactly like FUNSD. C1 compares train/validation against the full 401-document prior universe and repository history. Engine-pretraining exposure remains an interpretation limitation, not pipeline leakage; absolute OCR numbers must not be described as corpus-unseen behavior.

fresh_documents.source: further upstream volumes in release v1.5.0 (67 surveyed, 31 selected)
fresh_documents.status: excluded from fresh confirmatory headline material by benchmark design

ocrd_sbb.sgv1_confirmatory_eligible_pool: none for headline; possible challenge/dev material
ocrd_sbb.note: The cgv3-era benchmark design excludes OCR-D-SBB from fresh confirmatory headline material (historical German/Fraktur is the engine-availability stress track). SGV1 keeps that exclusion for headline claims; unselected volumes may be considered for development or explicitly-labelled challenge material, never silent headline pooling.

fresh_documents.status: requires new dataset manifest + checksums + license per-volume review

gt4histocr.note: Licensed CC-BY-4.0 but deliberately excluded from the headline benchmark for transcription-policy incompatibility (registry note). Candidate for verifier training diversity or a labelled challenge set only, which is a design decision to make in qualification, not a default.

synthetic.sgv1_confirmatory_eligible_pool: never -- synthetic output is labelled synthetic
synthetic.note: Development and smoke material only. Any SGV1 artifact produced from it carries synthetic: true and never reaches a headline table.
